launches.title: 🚀 Reality Defender: Deepfake Detection with Two Lines of Code
launches.tagline: We just made deepfake detection incredibly simple — with two lines of code
launches.body:
It’s been a few years since our[ 2022 YC HackerNews launch](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=30766050). We’ve since deployed realtime deepfake detection for tier-one banks, media and governments.

And one request kept coming: a **public API** to build deepfake detection into any stack.

# 🙌 **We heard you!**

We’re psyched to announce our that enterprise-grade deepfake detection **API + SDKs** are now exclusively available to **every YC developer** ahead of our public launch. And we’re **including 50 free scans per month**!

# **🎁 YC Early Access: [https://www.realitydefender.com/api](https://www.realitydefender.com/api)**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92611&key=user_uploads/868173/759df5fe-4e52-4f41-b197-7e87a97ca248)

**If your product touches voice or image, our API + SDKs gives it instant protection against:**

* 🎙️ AI-generated voice fraud
* 👤 Fake identities in IDV/KYC 
* 🗣️ Synthetic identities and media across consumer platforms
* 🚨 AI-manipulated images fueling disinformation

We **update and improve our models constantly** to stay ahead of emerging threats and built these API and SDKs with simplicity and transparency in mind.

# **🔥 YC Launch Offer**

* 50 free scans/month for YC Launch devs
* First 5 devs who integrate get get $250 + RD swag
* Email us at [hello@realitydefender.com](mailto:hello@realitydefender.com) for high volume access, or to connect with our infra/security leads

# **🔥🔥 Free Access for All Devs:[ ](http://app.realitydefender.ai)[Link To Sign Up](https://www.realitydefender.com/api)**
